## Acceptance cases

Case text from Bareline Product Blueprint 10_ACCEPTANCE_AND_TRACEABILITY.md (acceptance case text, 2026-09-30 revision).

| Case | Acceptance criterion | Journeys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC-003-01 | Select across emoji clusters, combining accents and opaque byte markers; text edits never split their atomic boundaries. | `plain_text` |
| AC-004-01 | Edit, save, edit again and undo to saved ContentStateId; the dirty marker clears without comparing monotonic revisions. | `plain_text` |
| AC-004-02 | Kill the process after each segment/journal/checkpoint flush boundary; recovery stops at the last valid durable record. | `crash_recovery` |
| AC-004-03 | Start a save then type; successful save clears only its captured state. Missing source regions disable Save/Save As and offer export with gaps. | `ui_regressions` |
| AC-005-01 | Match across a 16 MiB window in a 20 MiB line; case-fold results map to correct original TextOffsets. | `regex_transform` |
| AC-005-02 | Exercise lookbehind, anchors, empty matches and partial regex contexts; unsupported cases report incomplete and disable replacement. | `regex_transform` |
| AC-006-01 | Column insertion across tabs, wide glyphs and short lines follows display columns and undoes in one transaction. | `column_multi_cursor` |
| AC-008-01 | Validate paired Lexilla/native definitions for all 15 languages listed in FC-09; publish coverage and known grammar gaps. | `code_config` |
| AC-008-03 | Import malformed/oversized UDL input; reject unsafe structure and preserve the previous definition. | `udl` |
| AC-009-01 | Select main.rs then Cargo.toml; outline changes language and old-revision results never appear in the new document. | `workspace` |
| AC-010-01 | Pin a tab and reorder across views; pinned-first default and per-view selection persist after restore. | `split_clone_sync` |
| AC-010-02 | Add a compare alignment spacer; it receives no document line number and synchronized scrolling maps logical lines correctly. | `split_clone_sync` |
| AC-010-03 | Clone a document in a second pane; edits share a document while caret, selection, folds and scroll remain independent. | `ui_regressions` |
| AC-013-01 | Register PR-006 CommentProvider with a language; line/block toggles handle empty selections and undo correctly. | `code_config` |
| AC-014-01 | Record/replay only stable command IDs and explicit text; playback failure stops with a resumable location. | `macro_external` |
| AC-014-02 | Run a path and argument containing spaces, quotes and shell metacharacters using direct spawn; no implicit shell interpretation occurs. | `macro_external` |
| AC-014-03 | Cancel a process producing unlimited output; output storage stays bounded, process cleanup completes and the editor remains usable. | `macro_external` |
| AC-015-01 | Append to a log with a partial final page; verify continuity before accepting the new generation, without falsely entering SourceChanged. | `huge_log_tail` |
| AC-016-01 | Install a signed offline runtime and extension using the PR-001 provider contract; no PR-018 online code is required. | `extension_isolation` |
| AC-018-01 | Reject an expired, rollback, wrong-channel, wrong-publisher or hash-mismatched update before staging application files. | `install_update_rollback` |
| AC-018-02 | Verify signatures on inner executables after extracting final ZIP/installer; compare reproducibility only before signing. | `install_update_rollback` |
| AC-018-03 | Launch CLI with non-BMP paths and arguments via authenticated same-user IPC; portable mode writes only to its configured data root. | `portable` |
| AC-019-01 | Run paired baseline trials with pinned executable hashes, alternating app order and separate first-frame/editable/full-load timings. | `huge_log_tail` |
| AC-020-01 | Inject disk-full and process death at every recovery/replace receipt transition; reconcile originals, backups and committed targets by fingerprint. | `crash_recovery` |
| AC-020-02 | Test archive traversal, reparse escapes, IPC spoofing, stale signed metadata and compromised release-key recovery. | `install_update_rollback` |
| AC-024-01 | Use Narrator through open, edit, find, conflict and recovery; names, roles, values and focused state are announced. | `ui_regressions` |
| AC-027-01 | Format JSON containing large integers and exponent lexemes; preserve numeric values and documented lexical policy. | `extension_isolation` |

## Updating

- Record a scheduled run: download its `native-journeys-summary` artifact and run
  `python tests/e2e/readiness.py record summary.json --commit <sha> --date <yyyy-mm-dd>`.
- Remove a journey from `tests/e2e/quarantine.json` once it passes three consecutive nightly runs.
- Run `python tests/e2e/readiness.py render` after changing any input; the e2e unit tests fail on a stale ledger.
